title: The writer always runs the tests it adds
description: Fixes F848 (quality-gates-internal PLAN.md), a recurrence of the class P157.12 closed for one shape. Blocks the stage-2 re-measurement.
desiredOutcome: Every writer brief of a task that declares tests.add files lists a command that runs each of them, whatever the gate's slow steps are spelled as, or says why none could be derived
summary: P158: every tests.add suite reaches the writer brief through a derived command or a stated reason (F848); the phase review's four med findings fixed in P158.2

tasks.title: Every tests.add suite the task declares is run by a command the writer brief lists: a slow step that names none of them is extended to them when its runner takes suite paths, and otherwise the brief names each suite it could not give a command for and why
tasks.description: F848. At 8407a02d compose_writer_prompt (plugins/audit/scripts/status/audit-lookup.py ~1082-1150) moves a slow gate step to `Do not run ... left to the phase gate` and calls own_suite_command (~1049) to keep the task's own suites runnable; own_suite_command returns None unless the step's command already names a tests.add file. A whole-tree step - this repo's `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py`, whose recorded mean is past FOREGROUND_BOUND_MS on the stage-2 bases v01, v02, v08 - names none, so the brief lists only validate/lint and the writer runs no test it wrote. P157.12 fixed the shape where the slow step names the suite; this is the same class in another shape, so the fix is the invariant, not a third shape: every _fr.tests_add_files(task) entry is covered by a listed command or by a stated reason. Deriving the command: a single simple command whose runner takes suite paths (the sweep runner does: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/a.py`) gets the uncovered suites appended in place of its own path arguments; decide how a runner is known to take suite paths from what _phases already knows about script runners and say how you decided, rather than a list of program names. The plain arm of the measurement is composed by this same function (both arms read it), so the wording stays task-only. measure-context's ceiling for the writer brief must hold.

add: tests/test_audit_lookup.py: a task whose tests.add names tests/test_x.py and whose gate's only test step is a slow whole-tree python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py (no path) gets a Before you finish line running tests/test_x.py (red-first: today no listed command names it - own_suite_command returns None); a fast step already naming the suite adds no second line; two slow steps add one line per suite, never a duplicate; a compound or non-path-taking slow command yields a line naming the suite with the reason no command was derived, never silence (allow case: P157.12's cut of a slow step that names the suite is unchanged)

tests/test_audit_lookup.py: an invariant case over the composer - for every tests.add file of a fixture set of tasks (slow sweep, slow pytest, slow compound, fast steps only, no gate), the composed brief either lists a command naming that file or a line naming it with a reason
gate: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_audit_lookup.py tests/test_drive_phase.py tests/test__output_lints.py tests/test__deps.py tests/test__refs.py tools/_suite.py

tasks.title: A suite counts as run only by a command that really runs it: a filtered run is not a whole run, a suite goes only to a runner the plan hands that kind of suite, the phase gate's spellings are read, and the derived command keeps the step's own shell words
tasks.description: Phase code review of P158 (commit facd6f30, audit-lookup.py). MED1: _runs_whole_tree (~1168) reads any command whose non-flag words hold no path as a whole-tree run, so `python3 -m pytest -k smoke` counts as covering every suite and a tests.add suite gets no line; no case pins the branch (patching it to False leaves every ws case green). A whole run must be one the plan itself spells as the runner with no selection (no path and no selecting option), or count as not covering. MED2: suite_coverage (~1197) hands every unrun suite to the first known runner whatever the suite's kind; tie a runner to the kinds of suite the plan hands it (e.g. the suffix/extension of the paths it is spelled with) and give a reason line otherwise. MED3: _plan_commands (~1124) reads buildCommands values and tasks' tests.gate only; a phase testGate (and meta.fullGate when set) are plan spellings too, and the reason line must not claim no runner is known when the inherited gate spells one. MED4: _given_suites (~1165) shlex.quote()s every word after shlex split them, turning $ROOT/~ into literals; rebuild the derived command from the original command text (replace only the path words, keep the rest byte for byte), and give own_suite_command the same treatment so there is one way to derive a cut. LOW: --flag=suite words are lost (keep flags whole); non-suite tests.add files are handed to runners (filter with the suite-path reading); the compose_writer_prompt docstring still says the composition is the task alone's while it now reads the plan - state what it reads. One derivation shared by the cut and the extension, not two.

add: tests/test_audit_lookup.py: a fast listed 'python3 -m pytest -k smoke' (or --lf) is not a whole run, so a tests.add suite still gets a derived line or a reason line (red-first: no line today; _runs_whole_tree patched to False must turn a case red); a tests/ui.test.js suite is never handed to a runner the plan only ever hands .py suites, and gets a reason line instead; a task with no gate of its own inheriting a phase testGate that spells the sweep with a suite gets a derived command, not a false reason; a step spelled with $ROOT or ~ keeps that word unquoted in the derived command; a --only=<suite> flag word is kept as a flag, not replaced; a non-suite tests.add file (tests/fixtures/x.json) is not handed to a runner
gate: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_audit_lookup.py tests/test_drive_phase.py tests/test__output_lints.py tests/test__deps.py tests/test__refs.py tools/prove-gates.py tools/_suite.py

outcome.technical: plugins/audit/scripts/status/audit-lookup.py: one shared derivation for the cut and the extension - _runner_at (runner + first argument index, options read before paths), _slots (path-argument indexes, an option word such as --only=x is never a slot), _simple_command (one simple command whose shell_words values equal gate_entry_commands', else None), _rewritten (the step's own text with only the dropped path words removed and the inserted suites put at the first slot - every other byte as written, so a ROOT-variable word and a tilde-led word stay unquoted). own_suite_command now cuts through _simple_command/_slots/_rewritten (a non-interpreter command keeps its first word; a redirection is no longer cut). _given_suites removed. _suite_runner rebuilt on _runner_at/_slots. _plan_commands also reads meta.fullGate literal entries and every phase's testGate. suite_taking_runners returns {runner: kinds} (the extension of each suite path the plan hands it). _runs_whole_tree(command, known, suite) is a whole run only when the runner is known for the suite's kind, no path is handed and every word after the runner is -q/-v/--quiet/--verbose (_OUTPUT_ONLY_OPTION, _selects_cases). suite_coverage filters tests.add files by _manifest_phases.is_suite_path, hands each unrun suite to the first eligible step (_step_offer: single, known runner, no selecting option, rewritable) whose runner kinds include its kind, and names each suite left with clauses per blocker (_unrun_line: compound, not known, kind mismatch naming the runner and its kinds, selecting option, not rewritable); the all-compound/unknown wording is unchanged. compose_writer_prompt docstring now states what it reads (task, phase testGate when the task has none, buildCommands, every plan-spelled command). Added `import re`. tests/test_audit_lookup.py: new _writer_suite_reading_cases with ws21-ws27, ws18 fixture set gains 'fast filtered'. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: the suite_coverage paragraph restated (whole run, kinds, fullGate/testGate spellings, the one derivation, the reasons); the prove-gates anchor `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py` still occurs once (grep -c = 1). Mutations via an in-process scratch runner (shared tree untouched): _runs_whole_tree->False reds ws22 (+wp1-3); the old pathless reading reds ws21, ws18; kinds ignored reds ws23, ws27; _plan_commands without phase/fullGate reds ws24; re-quoting rewrite reds ws25; flags as slots reds ws26; suite_coverage without the is_suite_path filter reds ws27; _step_offer ignoring selection reds ws21; unmutated 188/188. Gate: sweep command exit 0, 7/7 files ok, 1943 cases. ruff 0, vermin 0. Live plan sanity: this task's own writer list keeps measure-context and gets `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_audit_lookup.py` as the cut; suite_taking_runners(live) = {tools/sweep-selftests.py: .py}. Dependants: tests/test__evidence_io.py, tests/test__filed_returns.py, tests/test_drive_phase.py import the module but use none of the changed names (grep of own_suite_command|suite_coverage|suite_taking_runners|_runs_whole_tree|_given_suites|_plan_commands|_suite_runner|compose_writer_prompt over the tree hits only the three files of this task plus historical evidence returns and phase shards) - still correct; test_drive_phase.py ran green in the gate. tests/test_audit_lookup.py - changed, by this task. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md - changed, the paragraph describing these functions. docs/research/pipeline-cost-design.md, plugins/audit/schema/audit-plan.schema.json, _clause_coverage.py, README.md, reference/execute-task.md, token-efficiency-audit.md, _doctor_hygiene.py and the other guide dependants name the module, executor.runsGate/own-tests/review.perTask or the guide file, none of which this change touches - still correct. .github/sweep-costs.json and tools/affected.py name the test file by path and _cases/_selftest - unchanged names, still correct; tests/test_audit_task.py uses _cli/_success_line_cases, untouched. Not done: bare-program runners (pytest, npx vitest) are still not suite runners for the extension - only interpreter-run ones, as before; a tests/ fixture is read as a suite by its directory and so gets a reason line rather than no line.
outcome.descriptive: The writer brief no longer counts a filtered run as covering a suite, hands suites only to runners the plan hands that kind, reads phase testGate and fullGate spellings, and derives commands from the step's own text.
